predecessors.name: Duchy of Silesia
predecessors.text: the Legnica lands inside Cliopatria's Silesian shape of 1241-1249

successors.name: Kingdom of Bohemia
successors.text: the Bohemian shape of 1314, which covers the Legnica lands

ledger.x: 1248: Bolesław II the Bald founds the Duchy of Legnica.
1251: Bolesław II pays his brother Konrad off with the new Duchy of Głogów.
1277: Środa Śląska and Strzegom pass to Legnica.
1290: Henry V becomes Duke of Wrocław.
July 1290: Henry III of Głogów contests Wrocław.
November 1293: Henry V is captured and the war for Wrocław ends in his defeat.
1294: Henry V buys his freedom with towns.
1311: Lower Silesia is split again and Wrocław goes to Henry VI the Good.
ledger.cp: Duchy of Wrocław of Henry VI the Good (1311-1335)

ledger.x: 1313: the last Cliopatria shape of the Duchy of Legnica.

wars.name: Wrocław-Legnica dispute of 1277
wars.outcome: Środa Śląska and Strzegom passed from Wrocław to Legnica in 1277; the Henry V page ties the acquisition of Środa to 'the release of Henry IV'.

wars.name: War for the Duchy of Wrocław (Henry V the Fat against Henry III of Głogów)
wars.outcome: After Henry IV Probus died (23 June 1290) Wrocław invited Henry V; Henry III of Głogów refused to abdicate.

certainty.note: The duchy's frontiers are lists of towns and castellanies; the pages give no treaty boundary.
